calculation.expression: -sum(pct_change(close),20) * clip(1 + zscore(VIX,60)/4,-, +) with multiplier clipped to [0.5,1.5]
calculation.description: Ranks assets higher when their trailing 20-trading-day return is lower, with the reversal score amplified during elevated VIX relative to its trailing 60-day mean and volatility. VIX is observation-only macro input and no order is placed for it.
